'''Delta Flight''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] paired with [[Echo Flight]]. [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] was once the flight instructor for the unit.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
